schemas.name: effects
schemas.sql: CREATE TABLE effects (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, kind TEXT NOT NULL, provider TEXT NOT NULL, endpoint TEXT NOT NULL, request BLOB NOT NULL, request_hash TEXT NOT NULL, quote_micro INTEGER NOT NULL, quote_evidence_sha TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, http_status INTEGER, response BLOB, response_hash TEXT, actual_micro INTEGER, detail TEXT, related_id TEXT, quote_metadata BLOB, started_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL, completed_at_utc TEXT)

schemas.name: events
schemas.sql: CREATE TABLE events (seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, effect_id TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, detail TEXT)

schemas.name: run
schemas.sql: CREATE TABLE run (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), contract BLOB NOT NULL, contract_hash TEXT NOT NULL, stopped INTEGER NOT NULL, exposure_micro INTEGER NOT NULL, generation_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, count_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, source_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL)

schemas.name: run_events
schemas.sql: CREATE TABLE run_events (seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, event TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL, at_utc TEXT NOT NULL)
